environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in private subnets (10.0.128.0/20, 10.0.144.0/20) with no NAT gateway or IGW route. Service is fronted by a Network Load Balancer registered as an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0f4e8c7a2b1d9e6f3). Consumer access requires: (1) the consumer VPC must have an interface VPC endpoint created for this service, (2) the endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled meaning each connection request must be manually approved by the service owner, (3) the NLB target group health check path is /healthz which is the only path not requiring auth. The ECS task security group sg-0x9y8z7w only allows inbound TCP/443 from the NLB's elastic network interfaces (prefix list pl-0abc123). There is no public IP assignment on the Fargate tasks, no IGW in the VPC route tables for private subnets, and the VPC has no peering connections to any VPC with internet access. DNS resolution for the service is only available via the VPC endpoint's private DNS entry.

config.network: private subnets only, no IGW, no NAT, no VPC peering to internet-connected VPCs
config.security_group: ingress only from NLB ENIs via prefix list pl-0abc123
config.route_tables: no 0.0.0.0/0 route in any associated route table
